notes.title: Content Update
notes.content: This build adds a new mp map and a new plane. The new map is set in an abandoned train yard and provides ample opportunities to evade enemies. The new plane is the F4 and emits corrosive gas which damages enemy planes that enter it. The gas will explode and cause severe damage to any planes within it's reach. This update also adds events which will be announced on social media. During these events, players can unlock planes by playing a fixed amount of matches (typically 3) instead of using earned combat tokens. The first mp event starts today at 3 PM EST / 20 GMT and will allow you to unlock the F4 by playing 3 matches.

notes.title: Update notes for 12/15
notes.content: Added in the final multiplayer abilities along with some misc. improvements.

notes.title: Latest Update
notes.content: This update adds some of the special abilities that all planes will eventually have.

notes.title: Update notes for Nov 30
notes.content: This build has improvements to the multiplayer match results screens showing badges earned and the winning player's profile.  This build also adds the champion's crown gameplay mechanic along with radar scans.

notes.title: Update Notes for November 9th
notes.content: This update adds some multiplayer enhancements such as ranking, an enemy scan, enemies on the radar, and in the air spawning.

notes.title: Update Notes for October
notes.content:
This update features a number of misc improvements and enhancements since the initial early access release but mainly syncs the PC version up with the upcoming Oculus store, Quest, and PS4/PS5 versions.

There will be a major update soon which will introduce a number of gameplay improvements but for now this update is mainly backend changes and updates.

notes.title: MP Update
notes.content: This updates adds some UI fixes and improvements (still more to come) and adds in a scoreboard, player muting, end of round results screen, and player name tags for multiplayer.  The in game scoreboard can be accessed via the "h" key on a keyboard or via the in game menu.
